component_types.name: Lower Engine Block
component_types.description: Fixed crankcase structure that supports the crankshaft and provides the lower moving-clearance envelope.

functional_features.label: Main bearing bores in the end walls
Open deck and upper wall rim

component_types.name: Crankshaft
component_types.description: Rotating member that converts the four connecting-rod forces into shaft torque.

component_types.name: Connecting Rod
component_types.description: Oscillating load path between one crank pin and one piston pin.

component_types.name: Connecting Rod Cap
component_types.description: Removable lower bearing half that closes a connecting-rod big end around a crank pin.

component_types.name: Piston
component_types.description: Reciprocating member guided by a cylinder bore and connected to a rod through a floating pin.

functional_features.label: Piston body and skirt outside running surface
Pin bores through the piston bosses
Boss faces and small-end guidance pockets
Skirt arched reliefs and lower moving envelope

component_types.name: Piston Pin
component_types.description: Floating journal that transfers load between a piston and connecting rod while permitting rod oscillation.

component_types.name: Socket Head Cap Screw
component_types.description: Fastener that clamps a connecting-rod cap to its rod body.

component_types.name: Piston Ring
component_types.description: Split resilient ring retained by a piston groove and sliding against the cylinder bore to support sealing.

external_entities.name: Upper cylinder block and cylinder-bore system

functional_features.label: Cylinder bores that guide the pistons
Lower mating face at the crankcase deck
Input coupling to the crankshaft output flange

interfaces.name: Crankshaft main-journal support in the lower block
functions: support the crankshaft on a stable axis
allow crankshaft rotation
locate the crankshaft axially

allowed: rotation about the shared journal axis

evidence.claim: The lower block and crankshaft share a constrained journal axis and locating face.
The lower block end bores are the crankshaft supports.
The crankshaft main journals are the supported rotating surfaces.

interfaces.name: Crank counterweight clearance inside the lower crankcase
functions: contain the rotating crank train
prevent contact between counterweights and the crankcase

allowed: counterweight rotation within the crankcase envelope
constrained: contact between the rotating envelope and crankcase wall

evidence.claim: The lower block provides the crankcase clearance envelope.
The counterweights define the principal rotating envelope.
The validated package rotates the crankshaft through the stationary lower block.

interfaces.name: Lower crankcase deck to omitted upper cylinder structure
functions: support and align the omitted upper cylinder structure
provide a continuous passage for the piston and rod system

allowed: no relative motion in normal service

evidence.claim: The open deck is the expected transfer surface to an upper engine structure.
The piston reciprocates above the open lower crankcase and requires an omitted guiding cylinder structure in a complete engine.

interfaces.name: Crankshaft output flange to external driven system
functions: deliver shaft rotation and torque to a downstream system

allowed: co-rotation when a coupling is installed
constrained: uncoupled relative translation under an installed joint

evidence.claim: The crankshaft profile identifies the flange as the output end.

interfaces.name: Connecting-rod split big end on a crank-pin journal
functions: carry one connecting rod on an offset crank journal
convert reciprocating rod force into crankshaft torque
allow relative journal rotation

allowed: rotation about the crank-pin axis

evidence.claim: The rod and cap bearing surfaces share the crank-pin journal axis.
The rod supplies the upper bearing half and load path.
The cap supplies the removable lower bearing half.
The validated motion preserves the rod-to-crank journal closure through the cycle.

interfaces.name: Bolted connecting-rod cap joint
functions: retain the cap on the rod
maintain the assembled big-end bore
carry clamp load across the split joint

allowed: no relative motion after fastening

evidence.claim: The cap and both fasteners are aligned and seated to the rod.
The two cap screws clamp each rod-cap pair.

interfaces.name: Piston boss bores supporting the floating pin
functions: support the piston pin in the piston bosses
transfer piston load into the pin
permit the intended pin float or rotation

allowed: pin rotation relative to the piston
limited axial pin float

evidence.claim: The piston boss bore and pin share an axis and end relationship.
The piston bores are the pin load-transfer supports.
The pin outer surface is the supported journal.
The validated motion preserves pin-to-piston joint closure.

interfaces.name: Connecting-rod small end oscillating on the piston pin
functions: transfer load between the pin and rod
allow the rod to oscillate as the piston reciprocates

allowed: rod oscillation about the pin axis

evidence.claim: The rod small-end bore and piston pin share an axis.
The small end is the oscillating pin bearing.
The validated motion preserves rod-to-pin joint closure.

interfaces.name: Connecting-rod small-end side guidance between piston bosses
functions: keep the rod small end centered between the piston bosses
provide side clearance for rod oscillation

allowed: rod oscillation with limited side float

evidence.claim: The piston boss faces form the rod side-guidance region.
The rod small-end boss is located between the opposed piston bosses.

interfaces.name: Piston running surface guided by an omitted cylinder bore
functions: guide the piston along its reciprocating axis
control piston side motion
keep the piston aligned with the crank-slider mechanism

allowed: axial piston translation

evidence.claim: The piston is the reciprocating guided member and its outside surface is the running interface.
The extracted lower crankcase is open and does not include the required upper cylinder-bore guide.
The validated package translates the pistons on fixed cylinder axes.

interfaces.name: Piston ring pack retained in the piston grooves
functions: retain the ring pack on the piston
locate each ring axially
permit the ring compliance needed for installation and service

allowed: limited ring movement within each groove
ring expansion at the split

evidence.claim: The piston grooves retain the ring pack.
Each split ring seats in a piston groove and remains compliant.
Three ring instances are carried by each piston subassembly.

interfaces.name: Piston ring pack sliding against an omitted cylinder bore
functions: maintain sliding contact with the cylinder bore
support sealing while the piston reciprocates

allowed: axial sliding along the cylinder bore
ring compliance against the bore

evidence.claim: The ring outer surface is the expected bore-sealing contact.
The piston carries the rings through the reciprocating stroke.
The required cylinder sealing surface belongs to an upper structure omitted from this extract.

interfaces.name: Piston skirt relief clearance to the rotating crank train
functions: prevent contact between the piston skirt and rotating crank webs near the lower stroke region

allowed: piston translation past the rotating crank envelope

evidence.claim: The skirt reliefs provide clearance to the crank webs.
The crank webs define the nearby rotating envelope.
The validated cycle exercises the relative skirt and crank motion.
